page: Microsoft Azure E128nds_v6 is an enterprise memory-optimized virtual machine operating on Microsoft Hyper-V virtualization. Built on an x86_64 Intel processor architecture, the instance allocates 128 dedicated vCPUs and 1024 GB of system memory, establishing a consistent 8.0 GB per vCPU allocation ratio. This high memory density accommodates data structures that exceed standard compute-focused memory limits.

Storage and connectivity specifications include 7560 GB of direct-attached NVMe SSD capacity, providing rapid local scratch and swap space alongside support for premium storage volumes. The configuration is classified under Azure network-optimized profiles, delivering high internal throughput. It does not include dedicated graphics processing units, centering resource allocation strictly on central processing, primary memory, and solid-state storage.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the consolidation of 128 dedicated cores and a full terabyte of RAM allows organizations to host large single-node environments rather than distributing across multiple smaller instances, reducing cross-node networking overhead. The bundled NVMe SSD storage eliminates secondary disk provisioning overhead for ephemeral data caches, though workloads requiring persistence across instance deallocations must still attach external managed disks.

The instance architecture is tailored for large in-memory databases, massive distributed caching tiers, transactional database engines, big data analytics, and enterprise resource planning systems that require extensive memory residency alongside rapid local temporary data access.
description: Microsoft Azure E128nds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance designed for data-intensive enterprise workloads. Powered by an x86_64 Intel processor architecture and managed via Microsoft Hyper-V, the instance supplies 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 1024 GB of system RAM, maintaining an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. A key architectural element of this configuration is its integrated 7560 GB local NVMe SSD array, which facilitates high-throughput, low-latency scratch space or caching without relying exclusively on remote disks. The instance features network-optimized capabilities and support for premium storage tiers, but does not include integrated hardware GPU accelerators. With its large memory footprint paired with extensive direct-attached NVMe storage, the configuration delivers strong resource density for enterprise relational databases, large-scale in-memory computing systems, and intensive extract, transform, load pipelines.
